reasons: The targeted replacement reduces only the Customer's non-renewal notice to 30 days while leaving HDI's 90-day window and all other Term language intact — a minimal operator/number-level edit.
The one-sentence insertion supplies the absent 60-day Vendor reminder mechanic, which the preferred position expressly requires and which no existing sentence covered.
The price-increase cap element is inapplicable: the clause contains no renewal price-increase mechanic, so no cap needed to be invented.
No undefined terms, contradictions, or dangling mechanics are introduced; 'Company', 'HDI', 'Effective Date' and 'Termination Date' all remain defined and effective.
